programme.title: Christmas in the Highlands
programme.desc: SCHOT IN SCHOTLAND. Deze kerst wordt Blair Henderson, een parfumexpert uit New York, door haar baas naar het afgelegen Schotland gestuurd om een zeldzame Schotse geur te vinden, The Heart of the Highlands.

programme.title: Feest op kerstavond
programme.desc: Eve, een partyplanner die moet beslissen of ze een last-minute evenement wil organiseren of op een romantische vakantie wil gaan. Terwijl ze beide tegen elkaar afweegt - wat zal ze beslissen?

programme.title: Thomas Kinkade's Christmas Cottage
programme.desc: Een blik op de inspiratie achter Thomas Kinkade's schilderij The Christmas Cottage, en hoe de kunstenaar gemotiveerd werd om zijn carrière te beginnen na zijn ontdekking dat zijn moeder hun ouderlijk huis dreigde te verliezen.

programme.title: A Song for Christmas
programme.desc: Twee alleenstaande ouders struikelen over de mogelijkheid van liefde voor Kerstmis, alleen om te ontdekken dat hun dochters verwikkeld zijn in een vervelende rivaliteit op school. Als de rivaliteit uit de hand loopt, kunnen hoop en genezing dan iedereen naar een vredig en vrolijk kerstfeest leiden?

programme.title: Kerstcupcakes
programme.desc: Als hun bakkerij vlak voor kerst moet sluiten moeten de zussen Kim en Gina samenwerken om een nationale bakwedstrijd te winnen om het familiebedrijf te redden en een grotere prijs te vinden dan ze hoopten.

programme.title: Puppy Star Kerstmis
programme.desc: De Pup Star-familie is net groter geworden! En de nieuwe pups Cindy, Rosie, Charlie en Brody moeten leren wat de ware betekenis van Kerstmis is. Als het team schurken van Pup Star van plan is om Kerstmis te verpesten, komen de pups op de Noordpool terecht om de kerstman en Kerstmis te redden...

programme.title: De Sleutel tot Kerstmis
programme.desc: Als een boze elf de Noordpool overneemt... ...draait ze de tijd terug en wordt de Kerstman steeds jonger. Snel. Een trouwe elf, een meisje met een magische sleutel... ...en de tiener-Kerstman moeten de toekomst van Kerstmis redden.

programme.title: Santa Who?
programme.desc: In dit hartverwarmende kerstverhaal lijdt de kerstman aan geheugenverlies na een val uit zijn slee. Al snel ontmoet hij een afgestompte televisiereporter die zijn enige hoop is om op tijd zijn geheugen terug te krijgen om de feestdagen te redden.

programme.title: Kerstharmonie
programme.desc: Een talentvolle singer-songwriter is verdrietig als haar vriend, de muzikant, het uitmaakt. Ze keert terug naar haar geboortestad om muziek, romantiek, familie en de magie van de kerstdagen te herontdekken.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina neemt haar intrek in de suite van haar vriendin in het Chesterton Hotel terwijl ze wacht tot haar scheiding rond is op eerste kerstdag. Daar begint ze een wervelende romance met een miljardair, die haar een aanzoek doet.

programme.title: K9 - Het Kerstverhaal
programme.desc: Cassie redt de voormalige K-9 politiehond Scoot. Daarnaast maakt ze nieuwe vrienden terwijl ze het kinderkoor helpt om geld in te zamelen voor de minder bedeelde kinderen.

programme.title: De Notenkraker Zoet
programme.desc: De kinderen verheugen zich op het feest op kerstavond als hun peetvader ze een vroeg kerstcadeau geeft: een Notenkraker. Dat leidt tot een gevecht tussen speelgoedsoldaten en een peloton muizen geleid door de Muizenkoning.

programme.title: Christmas Land
programme.desc: Sinds het tragische overlijden van Glinda heeft Christmas Land heeft betere dagen gekend, en Jules wordt gedwongen veel gecompliceerde beslissingen te nemen.

programme.title: A Storybook Christmas
programme.desc: Als evenementenplanner Celeste Everett, 30, haar bedrijf wil redden en haar nichtje een gelukkig kerstseizoen wil bezorgen, heeft ze hulp nodig, maar wanneer de nanny die ze inhuurt een man blijkt te zijn, beseft Celeste verrassend genoeg dat ze misschien ook kerstliefde voor zichzelf heeft gevonden

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: Wanneer Baxter Billings een klein fortuin wint in zijn plaatselijke winkelcentrum, besluit hij een geheime kerstman te worden voor de mensen in zijn geboortestad. Zijn anonieme filantropie werkt aanstekelijk en al snel verspreidt de vreugde van het geven met Kerst zich over de hele stad.

programme.title: Verdraaide Kerst
programme.desc: Een telepathische hond ontsnapt en rent recht in de armen van twee jonge broers. Maar de hoge pieten geven hun geheime wapen niet zomaar op.

programme.title: 12 Kersthonden: Puppyopvang
programme.desc: De kinderen van Doverville moeten een weeshuis redden van een immorele magnaat.

programme.title: 12 Honden van Kerst
programme.desc: Een weduwnaar stuurt z'n dochter naar haar tante in een stad die honden heeft verboden. Als ze een zwerfhond wil houden, wil ze de honden helpen en de burgemeester charmeren met een gedenkwaardig kerstspel.

programme.title: Een Wonder op het Kerstmeer
programme.desc: Als een tiener z'n beste vriend en z'n vader rond de kerst verliest stopt hij met ijshockeyen en verandert hij van vrienden. Als er een ijsbaan verschijnt op het bevroren meer, denkt hij aan de goede tijden.

programme.title: Broadcasting Christmas
programme.desc: Wanneer haar collega-presentator besluit de favoriete ochtendshow van Amerika te verlaten, kondigt Veronika Daniels aan dat ze haar nieuwe co-presentator zal kiezen uit een handvol kandidaten, waaronder Charlie Fisher, een lokale nieuwslezer in New York.

programme.title: Kerstbon
programme.desc: Een schaatskampioen geeft schaatsles... maar als haar ex-vriendje en nu beroemde ijshockeyer... zijn nichtje meeneemt voor lessen... krijgen de feestdagen een tweede kans op liefde.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Een Medea-Kerstmis
programme.desc: Een vrouw neemt haar vriendin mee op een verrassingsbezoek naar haar dochter op het platteland. De reis wordt echter alles behalve rustig, omdat de lokale inwoners klagen en elkaars geheimen vertellen.

programme.title: MXP: Most Xtreme Primate
programme.desc: Jack is terug en past z’n vaardigheden in de half-pipe deze keer toe op de ijskoude bergen van Colorado. Jack bundelt z’n krachten met twee snowboardende broers en hun vader en zet zo de hele snowboardwereld op z’n kop!

programme.title: Kerstmis Bij Familie
programme.desc: Kerstmis is allesbehalve gewoon als drie broers en zussen uit een nieuw gezin het niet eens kunnen worden. Met behulp van magie wisselen ze van lichaam en kunnen niet terug tot ze leren de feestdagen door te brengen als een liefdevol gezin.

programme.title: Santa Who?
programme.desc: In dit hartverwarmende kerstverhaal lijdt de kerstman aan geheugenverlies na een val uit zijn slee. Al snel ontmoet hij een afgestompte televisiereporter die zijn enige hoop is om op tijd zijn geheugen terug te krijgen om de feestdagen te redden.

programme.title: Feest op kerstavond
programme.desc: Eve, een partyplanner die moet beslissen of ze een last-minute evenement wil organiseren of op een romantische vakantie wil gaan. Terwijl ze beide tegen elkaar afweegt - wat zal ze beslissen?

programme.title: Christmas on Holly Lane
programme.desc: De beste vriendinnen Sarah, Cat en Riley komen weer bij elkaar in Sarah's ouderlijk huis om wat kerstmagie te creëren en de feestdagen te redden voor hun families.

programme.title: Jackie & Ryan
programme.desc: We volgen een alleenstaande moeder, die worstelt om in de voogdij van haar enige dochter te voorzien. Wanneer een treinreizende muzikant haar leven binnenstapt, besluiten de twee om hun omstandigheden te overwinnen met een krachtige relatie, die hun leven voor altijd zal veranderen.

programme.title: Thomas Kinkade's Christmas Cottage
programme.desc: Een blik op de inspiratie achter Thomas Kinkade's schilderij The Christmas Cottage, en hoe de kunstenaar gemotiveerd werd om zijn carrière te beginnen na zijn ontdekking dat zijn moeder hun ouderlijk huis dreigde te verliezen.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina neemt haar intrek in de suite van haar vriendin in het Chesterton Hotel terwijl ze wacht tot haar scheiding rond is op eerste kerstdag. Daar begint ze een wervelende romance met een miljardair, die haar een aanzoek doet.

programme.title: Looks Like Christmas
programme.desc: Van koken tot versieren, Carol slaapt en ademt Kerstmis, dus het is geen wonder dat de stad naar haar verwijst als “Christmas Carol”, maar wanneer een knappe man naar de stad komt en haar traditionele opvattingen over de feestdagen uitdaagt...

programme.title: A Storybook Christmas
programme.desc: Als evenementenplanner Celeste Everett, 30, haar bedrijf wil redden en haar nichtje een gelukkig kerstseizoen wil bezorgen, heeft ze hulp nodig, maar wanneer de nanny die ze inhuurt een man blijkt te zijn, beseft Celeste verrassend genoeg dat ze misschien ook kerstliefde voor zichzelf heeft gevonden

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: Wanneer Baxter Billings een klein fortuin wint in zijn plaatselijke winkelcentrum, besluit hij een geheime kerstman te worden voor de mensen in zijn geboortestad. Zijn anonieme filantropie werkt aanstekelijk en al snel verspreidt de vreugde van het geven met Kerst zich over de hele stad.

programme.title: A Gift for Christmas
programme.desc: BASED ON THE BEST SELLER BOOK - Darcy Archer is een romanticus, ze droomt ervan om gegrepen te worden door de perfecte man. In plaats daarvan botst Darcy op een dag op de fiets naar haar werk tegen een knappe, strak geklede vreemdeling die zijn hond uitlaat.

programme.title: A Family for the Holidays
programme.desc: Vorige kerst werd Miranda verliefd op de knappe Ian terwijl ze op zoek was naar haar lang verloren vader James Whitcomb, een beroemde theateracteur. Op verzoek van zijn weduwe Margaret stemt Miranda ermee in haar identiteit geheim te houden om de familie te beschermen tegen schandalen.

programme.title: Meerval-Kerstmis
programme.desc: Een jonge vrouw met liefdesverdriet die thuis is voelt de druk om weer te daten. Haar zus regelt een date met haar droomman, een profsporter. Maar niet alles is wat het lijkt en de ware liefde is misschien dichterbij.

programme.title: Kerstcupcakes
programme.desc: Als hun bakkerij vlak voor kerst moet sluiten moeten de zussen Kim en Gina samenwerken om een nationale bakwedstrijd te winnen om het familiebedrijf te redden en een grotere prijs te vinden dan ze hoopten.

programme.title: Wat Mannen Willen
programme.desc: In 'Wat Mannen Willen', de nieuwste Vlaamse RomCom, van het productiehuis Marmalade Films, volgen we de levens van zes - jawel - mannen op zoek naar de grote liefde of gewoon een beetje geluk in een tijd waarin mannen soms geen idee hebben hoe ze man moeten zijn...

programme.title: Christmas in the Highlands
programme.desc: SCHOT IN SCHOTLAND. Deze kerst wordt Blair Henderson, een parfumexpert uit New York, door haar baas naar het afgelegen Schotland gestuurd om een zeldzame Schotse geur te vinden, The Heart of the Highlands.

programme.title: Verdraaide Kerst
programme.desc: Een telepathische hond ontsnapt en rent recht in de armen van twee jonge broers. Maar de hoge pieten geven hun geheime wapen niet zomaar op.

programme.title: A Prince For Christmas
programme.desc: Kerstmis staat voor de deur en Jules Daly (Kate McGrath) doet haar best om een liefdevol thuis te creëren als nieuwe voogd voor haar ondeugende nichtje en neefje.

programme.title: Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.sub-title: S3:E3 Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.sub-title: S3:E4 Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew escapes the other ship and wormhole. Things are complicated when their new 'friends' sabotage Moya.

programme.title: Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: Eat Me
programme.desc: Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan full of cannibals and a scientist who can create clones.

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing
programme.desc: Moya rendezvous with Talyn who is seriously hurt. D'Argo and Rygel try to find Clorium, a drug to help Talyn.

programme.title: Green Eyed Monster
programme.desc: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.

programme.title: Losing Time
programme.desc: Moya's crew starts blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity.

programme.title: Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered with healing plants. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship to find Xhalax.

programme.title: Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn wants to fly into a sun. While near it Stark is contacted by an alien woman being held against her will.

programme.title: Scratch N Sniff
programme.desc: Pilot forces Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana to take a holiday as he is fed up with their bickering.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.sub-title: S3:E14 Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.sub-title: S3:E15 Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn leaves to grieve on a planet. She spots someone who might be her father but not all reunions are happy.

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.sub-title: S3:E20 Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.sub-title: S3:E21 Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.sub-title: S4:E2 What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.sub-title: S4:E3 What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.title: Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.sub-title: S4:E4 Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is enroute to meet with Moya. They eat Noranti's concoction and raiders entomb Rygel in amber.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Everyone reunites on Moya. Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims he saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.title: Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.title: I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.sub-title: S4:E8 I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.desc: When Moya is raided by Peacekeeper bounty hunters, everyone is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

programme.title: A Prefect Murder
programme.desc: While Moya's crew are resupplying on a xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect.

programme.title: Coup By Clam
programme.desc: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. But if not ingested by the same person, it becomes deadly.

programme.title: Unrealized Reality
programme.desc: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

programme.title: Kansas
programme.desc: Crichton accidentally alters the past, causing his dad to fly on the doomed shuttle 'Challenger'.

programme.title: Terra Firma
programme.desc: Crichton has arrived home. Although the crew relaxes, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

programme.title: Twice Shy
programme.desc: Moya takes on a new passenger, but she is an alien in disguise, intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

programme.title: Mental As Anything
programme.desc: The crew's males undergo training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes, D'Argo learns self control.

programme.title: Bringing Home The Beacon
programme.desc: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon that will allow Moya to camouflage.

programme.title: A Constellation Of Doubt
programme.desc: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a tv documentary.

programme.title: Prayer
programme.desc: Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities'. Aeryn resists torture on a Scarran ship.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.sub-title: S4:E19 We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.desc: The crew goes after Aeryn on a Scarran controlled station.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.sub-title: S4:E20 We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.desc: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends peace talks between Scarrans and Peacekeepers with a nuclear bomb.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.sub-title: S4:E21 We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.desc: Scorpius has betrayed the crew. Now they're all captured. The plan failed so the crew must help Scorpius.

programme.title: Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans travel through a wormhole to Earth, where those flowers grow.

programme.title: Premiere
programme.desc: Astronaut John Crichton is sucked through a wormhole into a distant part of the universe.

programme.title: Exodus From Genesis
programme.desc: A locator beacon on Moya is automatically broadcasting its exact location to Peacekeeper forces in the area.

programme.title: Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.sub-title: S1:E3 Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.desc: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.

programme.title: Throne For A Loss
programme.desc: Rygel is captured by bounty hunters. He stole a crystal from Moya and she will crash if it isn't returned.

programme.title: PK Tech Girl
programme.desc: The crew finds the Zelbinion battleship. They work to get the shield functional before it's attacked again.

programme.title: Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.sub-title: S1:E6 Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.desc: The crew visits a planet of happy workers. Rygel's fluids become explosive. Aeryn and Pilot must learn why.

programme.title: I, E.T.
programme.desc: A peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered.

programme.title: That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton and Crais's spirits are captured by Maldis, who thrives on hate. Zhaan takes a dark path to fight.

programme.title: DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew and promises to use it to find their home planets.

programme.title: They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute and gets ejected into open space.

programme.title: Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.sub-title: S1:E11 Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.desc: John and Aeryn avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole while flying his ship near a high flare sun.

programme.title: The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: Z'han joins her own people, but one of them wants something from her and will do almost anything to take it.

programme.title: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.title: Durka Returns
programme.desc: Moya collides with a Nebari ship. Durka is on board and has been mind cleansed. He now serves the Nebari.

programme.title: A Human Reaction
programme.desc: Moya travels through an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth.

programme.title: Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Moya tries to starburst to prove herself but it goes wrong when she gets split into several dimensions.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: A peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base.

programme.title: The Hidden Memory
programme.desc: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind. Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

programme.title: Bone To Be Wild
programme.desc: The crew find a planetoid that's a paradise occupied by a scientist and a girl. But one is a killer.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Moya's crew say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before trying to save Moya and her baby.

programme.title: Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them.

programme.title: Vitas Mortis
programme.desc: D'Argo does a sacred ritual to help an old Luxan survive. He draws energy from Moya making her age rapidly.

programme.title: Taking The Stone
programme.desc: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by thrill seekers who play life threatening games.

programme.title: Crackers Don't Matter
programme.desc: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya and everyone starts acting paranoid.

programme.title: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Chiana finds a recording with Moya's prior Pilot. Pilot orders Aeryn to leave after realizing she was there.

programme.title: Picture If You Will
programme.desc: Chiana buys a picture which is more than it seems. The picture shows Chiana what will happen to her.

programme.title: Home On The Remains
programme.desc: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn can tolerate the spores.

programme.title: Dream A Little Dream
programme.desc: After the Gammak base is destroyed, Zhaan is on trial for murder. Chiana and Rygel act as her defense lawyers.

programme.title: Out Of Their Minds
programme.desc: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.

programme.title: My Three Crichtons
programme.desc: Crichton is cloned into a version who is a de-evolved 'cave man' and another who has increased mental ability.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programme.sub-title: S2:E11 Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programme.desc: Princess Katralla, cannot ascend unless she finds a mate genetically compatible to her poisoned DNA.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.sub-title: S2:E12 Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.desc: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.sub-title: S2:E13 Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton faces 80 years as a statue. The Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into acid.

programme.desc: In July 1996, two men entered a pawnshop in Birmingham, Alabama and callously murdered the employees.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A drug dealer engaged in a shootout with Nebraska state troopers and evaded capture after a high-speed chase.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a career criminal committed a vehicular homicide in New Orleans, the FBI tracked him through his habits.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1980s, a pair of serial bank robbers took hostages and emptied bank vaults across the Midwest.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the summer of 1999, a brutal serial killer who traveled by train terrorized Texas. The FBI assembled a special task force to profile the violent drifter and help locate him.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In October 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1984, the son of a successful real estate developer was kidnapped in Miami. After the father received a $3 million ransom demand from a self-proclaimed terrorist, the FBI became involved and agents began to suspect a pair of Colombian nationals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1995, a South Carolina family was taken hostage as part of a bank robbery. Local police quickly identified two of the perpetrators but the criminal mastermind behind it all proved to be more elusive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In February 1988, a record store clerk in Ohio was fatally shot in his van. After discovering thousands of dollars in the vehicle, police knew that robbery was not the motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June 1973, a young girl was abducted from a state park while camping with her family. A criminal profiler predicted that the kidnapper would contact the girl's family on the one-year anniversary of her abduction.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1996, a group of political extremists robbed a bank in Washington using homemade bombs and military precision to escape. The FBI learned that the robbers might be preparing for a small-scale war with law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Chicago police and the FBI began to suspect that a law enforcement officer was responsible for the crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1988, a criminal confessed that two community members hired him to murder a South Carolina farmer.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In October 1993, a robber surprised unsuspecting customers by dropping through the roof of a California bank.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs officer disappeared from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects. The following day, the official was found dead.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Amid the cocaine wars of 1980s Miami, a multi-agency tactical squad suspected that a group of cops might be involved in illegal drug busts. The squad uncovered a ring of police who were making millions by ripping off smuggled cocaine.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Richmond, Virginia, two masked men who were robbing a bank escaped after opening fire on officers responding to the call. Agents found one bank teller dead, another wounded; the bank's security guard had been shot four times yet was still alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1993, an elderly man was found suffocated in his home with his checkbook, credit cards and vehicle stolen.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A Milwaukee teen was kidnapped by four gunmen who demanded $30,000 from his family for his safe return.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In December 1981, a New Jersey state trooper was shot to death on the side of Interstate 80. Fingerprints on the suspect's vehicle pointed to a fugitive wanted on bank robbery charges.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1980s, an illegal drug operation known as the K Street Crew opened its doors in Washington, DC.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 2000, the FBI was overwhelmed with investigations in Seattle which had the third-highest number of bank robberies in the nation. Agents focused on a series of heists in which two heavily armed men seemed to know where the banks stored their money.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A bank vault was blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables was missing. Agents were able to track down one of the robbers' friends and attempted to use him as bait to reel in the crooks.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After an Arkansas state trooper is shot and killed, officers catch the murderer and alert the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives when they find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a Washington, DC professor was shot and killed as she tried to get into her car, the latest incident in a series of violent carjackings. One week later, a man robbed a bank and security cameras captured the same vehicle as the getaway car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987, Cuban prisoners at the Atlanta Federal Prison broke out homemade weapons and stole from prison staff.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the spring of 1997, a killer preyed on senior citizens in the quiet town of River Parish, Louisiana.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1996, a series of bank robberies in Texas baffled authorities. But when similar thefts occurred the next year in California, FBI agents linked the crimes and established a modus operandi.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Two robbers with assault rifles ambushed an armored car, killing both guards and seizing thousands of dollars.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1997, two men used a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, New Jersey home. Police tracked the suspects to a nearby park but the criminals were able to escape after a nearly fatal shootout.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: This special episode examines previous cases to learn about the investigative techniques used by the FBI.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, a Croatian terrorist group committed acts against non-supportive Croatians in the United States.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1994, a rash of home invasions plagued the Detroit area. Each time, masked men disguised as police officers broke in with assault rifles and stole money and jewelry. But when one homeowner shot back, the identity of the intruders was revealed.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1985, a Lebanese terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian Flight 405 before taking off.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An escapee from Castro's Cuba was the mastermind behind a secret terrorist organization called Omega 7.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A Puerto Rican separatist group known as the FALN was suspected of setting off bombs in major U.S. cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990s Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power led to a full-scale mob war. Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1980s, the FBI matched wits with a cunning bank robber known as the Shootist. He had performed more than 50 robberies with military precision and was responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Los Macheteros terrorist organization sought to end U.S. rule of Puerto Rico through violence. When the group claimed responsibility for an attack on 18 unarmed servicemen traveling near San Juan, the FBI is called in to investigate the killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the mid-1980s, as drug profits grew, gangs ruled the streets of Chicago. Led by mastermind Jeff Fort, the dangerous, power-hungry El Rukn street gang attempted to conspire with Libya to perform acts of domestic terrorism for money.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1976, a car bombing in Washington DC's Embassy Row claimed the lives of a former Chilean ambassador.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980, a maid discovered that a copy machine, placed in a busy Las Vegas casino, was actually a bomb.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A special task force was formed in the early 1990s to combat the flow of Colombia cocaine into New York. As part of an elaborate sting operation, one detective went undercover and infiltrated a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a parole officer was found shot dead in his car, the FBI, DEA and NYPD struggled to contain the mounting violence from drug gangs that continued to escalate. Authorities sought to put two ruthless drug kingpins behind bars for the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the FBI investigated wide-scale corruption among the detectives of the San Juan, Puerto Rico Police Department. Drug trafficking, extortion, kidnapping and murder-for-hire were among the department's known illicit activities.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When an 80-year-old woman is found barely conscious next to the body of her murdered son in an abandoned van, the FBI was brought in and linked the crime to a teenager and middle-aged man.

programme.desc: Addy is being pummeled with whatever The Man can throw at her - and Lucy does the same right back.

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: In 1906, op het land van de Indianen van Oklahoma, vecht een cowboy voor oliepachtrechten tegen een hebzuchtige olieman terwijl een mooie lerares de harten van beide mannen steelt.

programme.title: Kill the Wicked
programme.desc: Barmhartige Samaritaan Benny Hudson en een gestrande vrouw Jenny worden gemarteld als ze per ongeluk een schuilplaats van een bende in een spookstad binnenlopen.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: Na per ongeluk de zoon van de cabaret danseres Kit Tilden te doden, probeert voormalig soldaat Yellowleg het goed te maken door haar begrafenisprocessie door gevaarlijk Apachegebied te escorteren. Samen met Billy en Turk moet hij Kit en de kist door vijandig land leiden om haar zoon te begraven bij haar overleden man.

programme.title: Pray to God and Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: Fernando keert terug uit zijn zelfgekozen ballingschap in Texas om wraak te nemen op de moord op zijn broers en zussen, maar besluit in plaats daarvan een revolutie te starten tegen de tirannie van de grootgrondbezitters.

programme.title: A Few Dollars for Django
programme.desc: Regan, een premiejager die sheriff wil worden, wordt naar Montana gestuurd om bankrovers te vangen. Hij neemt de ster over van een vermiste vervanger en raakt verwikkeld in een bittere oorlog tussen boeren en veehouders. Terwijl hij de misdadigers jaagt, moet hij zich staande houden in deze gevaarlijke strijd.

programme.title: Return of Sabata
programme.desc: De inwoners van Hobsonville huren een revolverheld in om zich te ontdoen van de McIntock-clan, die onder het mom van stadsontwikkeling gewelddadig en onrechtmatig belasting heft op de inwoners.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden doet zich voor als een gezochte man en sluit zich aan bij Gentry's bende om er later achter te komen dat Gentry degene is die zijn vader heeft vermoord. Hij redt Virginia Winters vader's ranch van Gentry en redt ook zijn lang verloren broer Spud.

programme.title: Fistful of Lead
programme.desc: Sartana krijgt te maken met verschillende partijen - waaronder een dappere rivaliserende revolverheld, een verleidelijke salooneigenaar en een Mexicaanse bandiet - die het goud van een mijndirecteur willen bemachtigen.

programme.title: Amongst Vultures
programme.desc: Old Surehand en Winnetou onderzoeken de moord op een moeder en haar dochter. Hoewel de echtgenoot denkt dat indianen verantwoordelijk zijn, vermoedt Old Surehand dat een beruchte bende achter de misdaad zit. De Vultures vermommen zich als indianen en laten zo een spoor van verwarring en geweld achter.

programme.title: The Desperado Trail
programme.desc: Na de Burgeroorlog proberen Rollins en zijn bandieten de vrede tussen kolonisten en Indianen te verstoren. Wanneer Winnetou wordt beschuldigd van de moord op de zoon van een opperhoofd, lijkt het bewijs tegen hem overweldigend. Old Shatterhand moet alles op alles zetten om zijn vriend te redden.

programme.title: Seven Alone
programme.desc: Een grensfamilie steekt per wagentrein de VS over, in de hoop op een beter leven in het Oregon Territory.

programme.title: $1,000 on the Black
programme.desc: Na 12 jaar keert Johnny terug naar het stadje waar zijn broer Sartana hem liet opdraaien voor moord en zijn geliefde afpakte. Sartana heerst nu als meedogenloze baas, beschermd door zijn moeder. Maar Johnny heeft zijn straf uitgezeten en komt met een doel.

programme.title: Winnetou and the Crossbreed
programme.desc: Op haar 21e verjaardag krijgt Apanatschi de geheime goudmijn van haar vader. Wanneer hebzuchtige goudzoekers het bestaan ervan ontdekken, ontstaat een gevaarlijk complot om de locatie te bemachtigen. Apanatschi roept Winnetou om hulp, maar dan verschijnt ook de bende van Curly-Bill.

programme.title: Django Challenges Sartana
programme.desc: Opgelicht voor een bankoverval, wordt Django's broer Steve gelyncht.

programme.title: Texas, Adios
programme.desc: Burt Sullivan verlaat zijn baan als sheriff om in Mexico wraak te zoeken op Cisco, de moordenaar van zijn vader. In een angstig dorp ontdekt hij een schokkend geheim en werkt hij samen met de bewoners om Cisco te stoppen en gerechtigheid te brengen.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: Na het erven van een stuk land in een stoffige plaats genaamd Trinity, komen de antagonistische halfbroers, Lester en Jesse, weer bij elkaar om verschillende ambities na te streven. Zullen ze ooit hun dromen waarmaken?

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 34, 35, 36
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: Gunfight at Red Sands
programme.desc: Een eenzame buitenstaander keert terug om de dood van zijn familie te wreken. Gewapend met vastberadenheid en gedreven door woede neemt hij het op tegen een bende genadeloze bandieten, wetend dat hij misschien alles zal verliezen in zijn zoektocht naar gerechtigheid.

programme.title: Only the Valiant
programme.desc: Kapitein Richard Lance wordt door zijn mannen en vriendin ten onrechte verantwoordelijk gehouden voor de dood van de geliefde Lt. Holloway door een indianenmoord. Holloway wordt gedood terwijl hij een gevaarlijk indianenopperhoofd begeleidt naar de gevangenis van een ander fort. Het opperhoofd ontsnapt. Wetende dat hun fort in gevaar is voor een Indiaanse aanval, neemt Lance een kleine groep buitenbeentjes mee naar een verlaten nabijgelegen legerfort om een bergpas te verdedigen tegen de naderende Indiaanse aanval. Hun missie is tijd rekken tot versterkingen uit een ander fort aankomen. De mannen in deze kleine groep van ontevredenen, deserteurs, psychopaten en lafaards haten kapitein Lance en wensen hem dood. Tot hun verdriet zien de mannen in dat Lance's overlevingsinstincten, militaire kennis en leiderschap de enige kans zijn voor de groep om in leven te blijven.

programme.title: Kill Johnny Ringo!
programme.desc: Texas Ranger Johnny Ringo probeert een bende valsemunters op te rollen, maar raakt verstrikt in een web van passie en verraad. Terwijl hij de driehoeksverhouding tussen de saloonzangeres Annie, haar minnaar Jackson en rancher Ray onderzoekt, ontdekt hij dat de ware dader dichterbij is dan gedacht — zijn eigen partner, de sheriff.

programme.title: Crazy Westerners
programme.desc: Geïnspireerd door het leven van Hank Garland, is CRAZY het verhaal van een legendarische gitarist die in de jaren vijftig uit Nashville kwam.

programme.title: Django, Prepare a Coffin
programme.desc: Een revolverheld vormt een bende van "overleden" executieslachtoffers om wraak te nemen op de politicus en outlaw die zijn vrouw heeft vermoord.

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Twee outlaws, “The Doctor” en de Indiaan Girolamo, helpen een dorp in de strijd tegen een bende en een corrupte sheriff die goud heeft ontdekt onder de stad.

programme.title: Alive or Preferably Dead
programme.desc: Twee broers, Monty en Ted, erven 300.000 dollar als ze zes maanden samenwonen.

programme.title: Savage Pampas
programme.desc: In de late jaren 1800 probeert een legerkapitein de open vlaktes van Argentinië, die worden beheerst door indianen en bandieten, te temmen. Om hem daarbij te helpen haalt de kapitein een groep vrouwen binnen om zijn soldaten tevreden te houden.

programme.title: Gunfighters Die Harder
programme.desc: Criminele bankiers plannen een verzekeringsfraude en huren een Mexicaanse bende in om het goud van de bank te stelen, maar ze betalen ook Lasky's bende om de Mexicanen te doden.

programme.title: Madron
programme.desc: Een non, de enige overlevende van een Indiaanse slachting op een karavaan, wordt opgevangen door een chagrijnige oude revolverheld.

programme.title: Day of the Outlaw
programme.desc: Blaise Starrett is een rancher die in conflict komt met boeren wanneer outlaws het stadje overvallen.

programme.title: Shango
programme.desc: Shango is een Texas Ranger die het moet opnemen tegen een voormalige Confederatie officier en zijn bende misdadigers die een lokale grensstad terroriseren op zoek naar goud.

programme.title: Day After Tomorrow
programme.desc: Premiejager Stan Ross komt naar de stad na een bankroof en krijgt van burgemeester Jefferson de opdracht de Mexicaanse bandieten te vangen. Maar in de bergen onthult bendeleider Espartero dat zijn mannen onschuldig zijn en zelfs met Jefferson samenwerkten. Stan ontdekt dat de ware macht en dreiging misschien in de stad zelf schuilen.

programme.title: Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Een cowboy begeleidt een klein meisje, wiens moeder haar de erfgenaam maakte van een te gelde gemaakt oliebedrijf, en moet haar beschermen tegen een outlaw terwijl ze op zoek gaan naar de vader van het meisje.

programme.title: Black Jack
programme.desc: Na een bankroof in het Wilde Westen verzamelt een bende zich rond leider Jack Murphy. Wanneer Skinner, Reb, Mathias en de broers Bill en Gordon ontdekken dat Jack de buit voor zichzelf wil houden, slaan ze de handen ineen om hem te verraden en nemen al snel actie.

programme.title: Bury Them Deep
programme.desc: Billy Gun berooft de legeruitbetaling. Het leger huurt Clive Norton in om het geld terug te halen. Norton redt een man van de galg die een hekel heeft aan Billy Gun: El Chaleco, Billy’s broer. Samen jagen ze op de beruchte outlaw.

programme.title: The General
programme.desc: Wanneer spionnen van de Unie de geliefde locomotief van een ingenieur stelen, achtervolgt hij deze eigenhandig en dwars door de vijandelijke linies.

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: De vurige blonde halfbloed Yellow Hair en haar gemakkelijke sidekick de Pecos Kid zitten achter een fortuin aan Mayagoud aan.

programme.title: For a Book of Dollars
programme.desc: Een premiejager genaamd Amen wordt ingehuurd door een groep nonnen om gestolen geld terug te halen. De nonnen zijn eigenlijk vrouwelijke desperado’s in vermomming die de buit willen terugvinden, geroofd door de outlaw Catapult en zijn bende.

programme.title: And Now... Make Your Peace with God
programme.desc: Twee mannen reizen naar Denver City om persoonlijke rekeningen te vereffenen: de een zoekt de moordenaar van zijn vader, de ander een vriend die zijn goud stal. Ze worden vergezeld door een mysterieuze scherpschutter. Samen begint een gevaarlijke jacht vol spanning en geheimen.

programme.title: The Oil Prince
programme.desc: De gewetenloze Olieprins verkoopt een bank niet-bestaande oliebronnen en stuurt kolonisten via een omweg om zijn bedrog te verbergen. Zijn plan lijkt waterdicht, totdat Winnetou en zijn bloedbroeder Old Surehand zijn plannen doorkruisen. De meedogenloze zakenman krijgt onverwacht sterke tegenstanders.

programme.title: Stagecoach (1939)
programme.desc: Een groep mensen die met een postkoets reist, wordt bemoeilijkt door de dreiging van Geronimo en leert daarbij iets over elkaar.

programme.title: Garden Of Evil
programme.desc: Drie Amerikanen op weg naar Californië stranden in een Mexicaans dorp en krijgen een aanbod: een vrouw helpen haar man te redden uit een ingestorte goudmijn. In de gevaarlijke bergen twijfelen ze tussen hebzucht, overleving en hun ware intenties.

programme.title: Flaming Frontier
programme.desc: Old Surehand en Old Wabble jagen op ‘The General’, een meedogenloze moordenaar die Old Surehands broer heeft gedood. Tijdens hun zoektocht raken ze verstrikt in het conflict tussen kolonisten en Comanches, dat dreigt uit te monden in oorlog. Met Winnetou aan hun zijde gaan ze de strijd aan.

programme.title: Last of the Renegades
programme.desc: Wanneer kolonisten Assiniboin-gebied binnendringen, dreigt oorlog. Winnetou, Old Shatterhand en Lord Castlepool proberen de vrede te bewaren, maar de corrupte oliemagnaat Bud Forrester heeft andere plannen. Door aanvallen te ensceneren en de Indianen de schuld te geven, wil hij hun olierijke land bemachtigen.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Pan-seared Scallops with Peanut Sauce Noodles and More!
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including pan-seared scallops with peanut sauce noodles and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Pine Nut Pesto Scallops with Apple Celery Slaw and More!
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Pine Nut Pesto Scallops with Apple Celery Slaw and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Start Here by Sohla El-Waylly! Follow along as Shahir makes a punch-you-in-the-face sauce, beautiful seared scallops, an indulgent chocolate pudding pie for grown-ups, and much more!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
